dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Sure, Dogecoin has its charm for quick, low-cost transactions, but Bitcoin's established infrastructure and value as a store of wealth can't be overlooked. They serve different purposes in the crypto ecosystem.

@cb_doge Each has its place - Bitcoin for value storage, Dogecoin for transactions thanks to its lower fees and faster confirmation times. It's not just about which is better, but what they're best used for!
